About Upeya

Upeya Electronics LLP is an Ahmedabad-based technology company that has been building IoT, AI and software solutions since 2017.

Whether you’re planning a connected device, an AI or machine-learning product, a mobile or web app, or a data analytics system, we work with you from the first idea to a working product. Tell us who will use the software, what they need to do and which systems it should connect to, and we’ll get back to you with a clear plan.

Our team works across IoT, AI/ML, mobile app development (Flutter and React Native), Python and Django, Java, JavaScript, big data and data analysis, and AR/VR, so you can bring everything to one team instead of coordinating several vendors.

How we build your software

  1. Define the project.

    We agree on who will use the software, which problem it should solve, and what the first version needs to do.

  2. Design the workflow.

    You review a sketch of the main screens and see how information moves between your users, devices, and systems.

  3. Build a prototype.

    We test the most important interaction first. For a connected-device project, that might mean getting one sensor reading onto a phone.

  4. Develop and integrate.

    We build the agreed features and connect them to your existing devices, APIs, or business tools.

  5. Test with your team.

    Your team tries the software on everyday tasks. We review the results together and resolve issues before launch.

  6. Launch and hand over.

    We release the software, share a guide for your team, and agree on any ongoing support.
